description: For a family of domains \(M_i\) and an ultrafilter \(\mathcal U\), the relation \(f\sim g\) defined by \(\{i:f(i)=g(i)\}\in\mathcal U\) is an equivalence relation on \(\prod_i M_i\).
signature: Filter.productSetoid.{u_1, u_5} {α : Type u_1} (l : Filter α) (ε : α → Type u_5) : Setoid ((a : α) → ε a)
